about_short_description.short_description: ClassIn is an online platform that provides solutions for virtual learning and online merge offline services.

product.name: ClassIn Virtual Classroom
product.description: A cloud-based interactive classroom for synchronous online teaching, with tools for whiteboarding, screen sharing, group work, chat, media, assessments, recording, and class administration.

product.name: ClassIn Hybrid Learning
product.description: A hybrid teaching solution that connects in-person and remote learners through live classes, classroom capture, interactive teaching tools, recordings, and learning management features.

product.name: ClassIn Learning and School Management
product.description: Administrative and learning-management capabilities for scheduling lessons, assigning teachers, organizing resources, managing homework and tests, tracking progress, and generating learning reports.

product.name: ClassIn LTI Integrations
product.description: Learning Tools Interoperability integrations that connect ClassIn with learning platforms and calendars for class scheduling, classroom access, recordings, schedules, and learning analytics.

identifier.value: ClassIn SDK and API Integration Services

product.name: ClassIn SDK and API Integration Services
product.description: Developer integration capabilities that allow education technology and software providers to incorporate ClassIn classroom and learning functions into their own applications and workflows.

product.name: ClassIn X for Classrooms
product.description: A Windows application that connects physical classrooms to ClassIn’s cloud environment, enabling schools to deliver and manage hybrid lessons.
